original_method: Bind board revision, PSU/VR/domain and every named rail; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web pages; normalize volts/millivolts, scaling, nominal value, tolerance and thresholds; compare each rail passively while preserving power/VR/PSU/SEL context and avoiding live probing.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - VOLT'` invents a record and OOB-only/truncated data omits full IB/Web and per-rail evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, map every voltage record to the approved power tree, capture complete Web rows and compare units/scaling/limits read-only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB lists, VOLT view, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; source quoting is preserved and log clearing withheld.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a power-tree matrix joining each electrical rail to stable IB/OOB/Web records and compare scaled values, nominal/tolerance and thresholds under a documented load state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds electrical attribution and unit/scaling controls without active probing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single voltage reading cannot prove all rails, and an unapproved unit conversion can hide serious over/undervoltage errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Values depend on load and sensor accuracy; telemetry comparison does not substitute for calibrated electrical measurement unless the specification says so.

project_override_considerations: If telemetry accuracy itself must be validated, an approved calibrated measurement procedure is a separate manual checkpoint. Extra outer quotes are preserved as a source defect, not silently edited.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and source-format defect record
SUT/BMC/board/PSU/VR identity, versioned power tree and full rail spec/map
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence for every rail
Power/load/redundancy context, criteria 3–30 decision, no-probe/no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2026 Wistron-BMC-01046-V002: confirm whether the extra enclosing quotation marks are formatting-only, whether Criteria 1, 2, 31 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–30 are missing, and provide the complete rail/power-tree population with units, scaling, nominal/tolerance/threshold values and IB/OOB/Web mapping.

review_improvement: Converts broad VOLT filtering into a per-rail electrical matrix, rejects the fabricated title sensor and preserves both source-format defects for owner decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: Voltage telemetry is meaningful only when tied to a specific rail, scaling and load condition. Identical numeric values in different units or domains are not equivalent, and a single normal rail cannot prove the power tree. Passive collection avoids electrical risk, but the extra quotes and criteria 3–30 cannot be corrected by inference.
